resolution.title: [restart_ptf] remove vlan port before adding to avoid potential conflict
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #4481

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fixes #4481
Vlan ports conflicted during restart-ptf.

#### How did you do it?
Remove vlan port before adding to avoid potential conflict.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Manually add duplicated vlan port during restart-ptf, and now it can avoid the conflict by removing and adding again.
And then run the test case bgp/test_bgp_fact.py and it passed.

### Documentation
